_plan.section_job: Lay out the three estimating equations + the descriptive identification logic: how each prediction hits the data and what must hold.

_plan.serves: Exactly how each prediction maps to a test + the assumptions behind each estimand.
_plan.boundary: Estimators + identification only. Variable DEFINITIONS -> 2.3/2.5/Appendix. Data/sample-build -> 3.1. No results preview.
_plan.thin_claim: Descriptive estimand, NO identification; honest about the never-acquirer baseline, first-deal contamination, and inference choices.

MA3 = src/f1d/econometric/empire_cashspec_interaction.py:90. All three share CTRL = [Leverage, lnAssets, TobinsQ, ROA, Capex, DivDummy, sCFO] (7; 'base minus Lagged_DV'). PanelOLS, two-way FE (EntityEffects=firm, TimeEffects=cal year-qtr), firm-clustered SE.
_plan.two_control_sets: STAGE-1 (residualization, 2.3 eq-4): {UncPre, UncQue, NegCall, StockRet, MarketRet, EPSgrowth, SurpDec} + CEO FE + Year FE. STAGE-2 (these 2.4 designs): {Leverage, lnAssets, TobinsQ, ROA, Capex, DivDummy, sCFO} + firm FE + cal-year-qtr FE. DISTINCT sets -- must not be conflated.
_plan.catch3_closure: Our eq-4 (run_h0_3_ceo_clarity_extended.py:369, CEO_Baseline) controls EXACTLY match the verified DWZ set -> it is literally eq-4 (residual = CEO_Baseline model.resid). Catch-3 CLOSED 2026-06-13.
carried_seams: SEAM-A (sample): MA1 DROPS post-announce quarters (e>=0); MA2 KEEPS them (capped +4) for the GAP/POST bins. Different estimation samples -> state explicitly; MA1's beta is a pre-only mean shift, MA2 traces the full event path.
SEAM-B (layered time FE): stage-1 eq-4 has Year FE; stage-2 designs add cal-year-qtr FE. Different grain, two stages -> not double-absorbing; confirm intended.
SEAM-C (generated-regressand): UncRes (stage-1 residual) is the stage-2 DV -> the 2.3 P3 two-step-SE concern propagates to every 2.4 design.
SEAM-D (baselines differ): MA1/MA2 baseline = never-acquirers + own pre-quarters; MA3 baseline = never-EITHER acquirers. State the difference.

P1.lit_body: the main run-up DiD + the common estimand frame
P1.intent: Give the main estimating equation (MA1) and the common panel frame: within-firm two-way FE, firm-clustered SE, post-announce dropped, never-acquirer baseline, PreAnnounceQtr = 1[e=-1].
P1.serves: The template every design specializes; maps to H1 (claim C2).
P1.boundary: Estimator + estimand only; variable definitions -> 2.3; no results.
P1.thin_claim: beta is a descriptive pre-announcement (anticipation) mean shift -- no causal/identification claim (RULE-COH-2).
guardrails: Equation transcribed from gen_empire_did_table.py:141 (CTRL :47); not memory.
SEAM-C: the DV UncRes is a generated regressand (2.3 P3) -> carry the two-step-SE caveat.

propositions.statement: Main estimating equation (MA1): Y_it = beta*PreAnnounceQtr_it + gamma'X_it + alpha_i + tau_t + epsilon_it, where X = {Leverage, lnAssets, TobinsQ, ROA, Capex, DivDummy, sCFO}, alpha_i = firm FE, tau_t = calendar year-quarter FE; standard errors clustered by firm.
propositions.verification_plan: Transcribed from code (primary source). No NLM.

propositions.statement: PreAnnounceQtr_it = 1[e = -1] (e = call quarter - first >=50%-cash announcement quarter). Post-announcement quarters (e >= 0) are dropped from the sample; never-acquirers (e undefined) serve as the fixed-effects baseline.

beta is the estimand: a within-firm pre-announcement (anticipation) shift in outcome Y, identified off the treated firm's pre-announcement quarter relative to its own earlier normal quarters; never-acquirers primarily anchor the calendar-time (year-quarter) effects rather than serving as the within-firm contrast. A descriptive contrast, not a causal effect. (Matches 2.2 H1's 'own other quarters' framing.)
propositions.verification_plan: Framing; RULE-COH-2 (callback P7 register); aligned to 2.2 P2.1 within-firm wording. Write-time pass.

P2.intent: Give the event-study spec (MA2): replace the single indicator with four event-time bins; the GAP bin is the MNPI discriminator; PRE2 is the pre-trend validity device.
P2.serves: Maps to H1b (claim C1, strongest result); the GAP-vs-completion contrast.
P2.thin_claim: The round-trip is the contrast; do NOT over-read the negative POST.
guardrails: Equation transcribed from empire_drop_test.py:149 (BINS :41); not memory.
GAP discriminator (matches 2.2 P4): uncertainty ~0 at GAP (announced, NOT closed) while cash persists -> the MNPI fingerprint; do not flatten GAP+POST.
SEAM-A: MA2 KEEPS post-announce (capped +4) whereas MA1 drops it -> different sample.

propositions.statement: Event-study (MA2): Y_it = sum_b beta_b * Bin_b,it + gamma'X_it + alpha_i + tau_t + epsilon_it, with bins PRE2 (e=-2), PRE1 (e=-1), GAP (e>=0 announced & not yet closed), POST (e>=0 & completed); baseline (omitted) = e<=-3 and never-acquirers. Post-window capped at +4 quarters; truncated at a firm's second announcement; withdrawn-deal post rows dropped.

The discriminating contrast is the Wald test on beta(PRE1) - beta(GAP): if uncertainty drops at the GAP (announced, not yet completed), the gag-lift-at-announcement reading is supported over outcome-resolution-at-completion. PRE2 is the pre-trend validity check (expected ~0).
propositions.verification_plan: Transcribed from code. Framing of the contrast = write-time. No NLM.

propositions.statement: The event study is run for cash acquirers and, as a placebo, for stock acquirers; all bin coefficients and Wald drops are reported two-tailed.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Cash arm + stock placebo + inference convention.

P3.lit_body: the pooled interacted spec + formal cash-specificity -> H1a
P3.intent: Give the pooled interacted spec (MA3): both treatments in one model, with the formal cash-minus-stock Wald test.
P3.serves: Maps to H1a (claim C6, the formal cash-specificity test).
P3.boundary: Estimator only; the EFFECT/CAUSE separation framing lives with the result, not here.
P3.thin_claim: The Wald difference IS the formal test (avoids the Gelman-Stern 'sig vs n.s.' fallacy); supportive-not-definitive (imprecise stock arm).
guardrails: Equation transcribed from empire_cashspec_interaction.py:90; not memory.
SEAM-D: baseline here = never-EITHER acquirers (differs from MA1/MA2).
EFFECT-not-CAUSE (matches 2.2 P3): the cash-build-up CAUSE leg is NOT cash-specific (C6); claim only the EFFECT.

propositions.statement: Pooled interacted spec (MA3): Y_it = beta_c*PreAnn_cash_it + beta_s*PreAnn_stock_it + gamma'X_it + alpha_i + tau_t + epsilon_it, where PreAnn_cash = 1[cq = dq_cash - 1], PreAnn_stock = 1[cq = dq_stock - 1]; the sample keeps only quarters before a firm's first deal of EITHER type plus never-either firms (never-either = FE baseline).
Formal cash-specificity is the Wald test on (beta_c - beta_s) > 0 -- a single linear-restriction test, not a comparison of one significant and one non-significant coefficient.

For the CashRatio (cause) outcome the spec adds CashRatio's own one-quarter within-firm lag (partial-adjustment, consecutive quarters only) so the pre-announce coefficient tracks the CHANGE in cash; the residual UncResCEO outcome takes NO lagged DV.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Functional-form note for the cause column.

P4.lit_body: estimands + descriptive identifying assumptions + design->hypothesis map
P4.intent: State the descriptive identifying assumptions common to the three designs and map each design to its hypothesis.
P4.serves: Makes the 'what must hold' explicit while staying descriptive (no identification claim).
P4.thin_claim: Within-firm anticipation contrast; NO parallel-trends causal claim; PRE2 as the validity device, not a DiD identification proof.
guardrails: RULE-COH-2: NO parallel-trends/causal claim -- the estimand is descriptive.
SEAM-A/B/D must be stated: sample differences (drop vs keep post), layered time FE (year vs cal-year-qtr), baseline differences (never-acquirer vs never-either).

propositions.statement: Common identifying assumptions, stated descriptively: identification is within-firm (firm FE) and within calendar-time (year-quarter FE); the estimand is the pre-announcement mean shift relative to the firm's own normal quarters and to non-acquirers; PRE2 (the pre-trend bin) is the validity device; no parallel-trends or causal claim is made.
Design-to-hypothesis map: MA1 (single pre-announce indicator) tests H1; MA2 (event-study bins) tests H1b; MA3 (pooled cash/stock interaction + Wald) tests H1a.

Two distinct control sets operate: the stage-1 residualization controls (eq-4: linguistic + performance, with CEO and year FE) and the stage-2 design controls (firm financials, with firm and year-quarter FE). The outcome UncResCEO is already net of the stage-1 set; the stage-2 designs add the firm-financial controls and finer time FE.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Distinguishes the two control sets (SEAM-B); pre-empts double-counting confusion.

propositions.statement: Inference choices to disclose: standard errors are firm-clustered in MA1-MA3 (some validity tables use two-way firm x calendar-quarter); focal treatment tests are reported one-tailed in places and should be moved to two-tailed for honesty (the load-bearing results survive two-tailed: C1/C6 already two-tailed, C2 run-up survives at p=.0074).
propositions.verification_plan: Numbers bible-verbatim. Clustering-methodology cites (petersen2009/cameron2011) deferred to write-time. Note the clustering LEVEL also shifts across stages: stage-1 eq-4 clusters on CEO, stage-2 designs cluster on firm.

propositions.statement: Contamination/endogeneity to disclose: deal timing is endogenous; only the FIRST deal sets the event clock, so later deals can pollute the baseline -- mitigated by truncating each firm's post-window at its second announcement, but the never-acquirer baseline and first-deal focus remain assumptions, not identification.
propositions.verification_plan: Transcribed from code + honest framing. No NLM.

propositions.statement: Functional-form choices to disclose: outcomes are levels/word-shares (not counts); the CashRatio cause regressions use a partial-adjustment lag (cash is sticky, rho ~0.78) while residual outcomes do not; the generated-regressand status of UncResCEO (2.3) implies the two-step-SE caveat applies to every design here.
propositions.verification_plan: Transcribed from code; cross-link to 2.3 P3. rho~0.78 bible-verbatim/code. No NLM.

propositions.statement: The firm-financial design controls (Leverage, lnAssets, TobinsQ, ROA, Capex, DivDummy, sCFO) follow the standard cash-determinants regression; the cash-equation specification is grounded in that literature, framed mechanically (cash as a by-product of retained free cash flow), NOT as purposive war-chest saving.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Grounds the cash-design controls; RULE-COH-3 guard.

propositions.statement: Sample-selection disclosure: the residual outcome UncResCEO exists only for CEOs with >=5 conference calls in the Main (non-financial, non-utility) industry sample -- the universe in which the stage-1 eq-4 residual is estimated. Because every design drops observations lacking the DV, all focal H1/H1b/H1a uncertainty regressions run on this >=5-call, Main-industry subsample (which skews to larger, more-covered firms); the CashRatio outcomes use the full panel. Disclose this as a selection threat to external validity.
propositions.role_in_paragraph: Selection disclosure (advisor catch A; claim C2 risk).
